# golaberto

> O banco de dados aberto do futebol — campeonatos, tabelas, jogos, gols e elencos, mantido pelos seus leitores.

## Overview
Publicly accessible web application.

## Screens
- [Principal](/): principal screen
- [Campeonatos](/campeonatos): campeonatos screen
- [Jogos](/jogos): jogos screen
- [Equipes](/equipes): equipes screen
- [Estádios](/estadios): estadios screen
- [Árbitros](/arbitros): arbitros screen

## Data Models
- `AppUser`: domain entity
- `Category`: domain entity
- `Championship`: domain entity
- `HomeChampionship`: domain entity
- `Phase`: domain entity
- `Group`: domain entity
- `Zone`: domain entity
- `Stadium`: domain entity
- `Team`: domain entity
- `TeamChampionship`: domain entity
- `TeamGroup`: domain entity
- `Referee`: domain entity
- `GeographyRegion`: domain entity
- `GeographyCountry`: domain entity
- `TeamDirectory`: domain entity
- `Player`: domain entity
- `TeamPlayer`: domain entity
- `TeamRoster`: domain entity
- `TeamPlayerHistory`: domain entity
- `Game`: domain entity
- `Goal`: domain entity
- `PlayerGame`: domain entity
- `Standing`: domain entity
- `TeamChance`: domain entity
- `ZoneChance`: domain entity
- `PositionChance`: domain entity
- `GameImportance`: domain entity
- `TeamRating`: domain entity
- `PlayerRating`: domain entity
- `RatingEval`: domain entity
- `GameCard`: domain entity
- `HomeGameCard`: domain entity
- `MatchesGameCard`: domain entity
- `TeamGame`: domain entity
- `Comment`: domain entity
- `PlayerStat`: domain entity
- `PhaseRound`: domain entity
- `TeamComment`: domain entity
- `TeamCampaignPoint`: domain entity
- `TeamOddsHistory`: domain entity
- `TeamRatingChart`: domain entity
- `TeamOddsChart`: domain entity
- `TeamRosterTotal`: domain entity
